summary.intent: Replace the Ted Lasso quotes/theming on the front page of the tedlasso-strava site with Machiavelli quotes, mapping the ten existing mood-engine branches to new Machiavelli-themed moods.
summary.outcome: Rewrote the mood catalogue (10 new moods, 35 quotes from The Prince and Discourses on Livy), renamed all engine mood ids and propagated the rename through domain code, rendering, tests, and docs; all 333 tests pass, typecheck is clean, coverage held, and the branch was committed and pushed.

repo: Mood ids in src/domain/mood.ts are load-bearing: they're returned by the engine and persisted in KV snapshots, so renaming them requires touching src/data/moods.ts, src/domain/mood.ts, src/worker.ts, src/app/render.ts, src/app/catalogue.ts, and every test fixture that references a mood id or name.
Mood accent hex colors are already WCAG-verified against both newsprint stocks by test/data/moods.test.ts; reusing the same accent per engine slot avoids needing new contrast verification.

The repo/Worker name and REDIRECT_URI intentionally still say 'tedlasso-strava' even after the content rebrand, since renaming those breaks the deployed URL and Strava OAuth callback — only the rendered page content and docs were rebranded.

test/data/moods.test.ts's 'some moods have GIFs' test originally asserted withGifs.length > 0, which breaks under an all-empty media catalogue — the test needed rewriting to allow zero media as a legitimate state.
pickQuote's media-present branch has no real catalogue data to exercise it (media: [] everywhere since the rebrand); it's covered only via a synthetic mood fixture in test/domain/quote.test.ts.

Catalogue staleness test (test/app/catalogue.test.ts) previously aged the clock past the newest catalogue verifiedOn to trigger the stale-marker; with zero media entries there's nothing to age, so the test was rewritten to assert no stale marker ever appears for an all-text catalogue.

code.finding: Mood/Quote/Media interfaces unchanged; Media kind stays 'gif'|'image'|'video' and rendering paths remain even though the catalogue currently ships media: [] for every mood, since a mood MAY carry media again later.

Page <title> suffix was hardcoded as '${mood.name} — tedlasso-strava</title>' and was changed to 'il-principe-strava' to keep the front-page title clean of the old branding while leaving deployed identifiers untouched.

workflow: Used a python3 heredoc script with an ID_MAP dict to do bulk, assertion-guarded find/replace across many test files in one pass (asserting old string presence before replacing) — effective for large mechanical renames across many files while catching missed occurrences immediately via AssertionError.

Verified visual output of a server-rendered HTML page by bundling a throwaway dump script with esbuild, running it with node, writing HTML to a scratchpad file, then stripping tags with a regex to eyeball text content, rather than relying solely on test assertions.
Ran tests red-first after the id/catalogue rewrite (TDD) to confirm all 21 failures pointed at expected missing ids before writing the new catalogue.
Used AskUserQuestion / brainstorming skill to resolve one design decision (title suffix) before implementing a change that touched many files.

friction: node_modules was missing initially, requiring an npm install before tests could run.

Verifying rendered HTML required a workaround (temporary test file, then an esbuild-bundled dump script) since there was no direct way to preview the rendered page output within the assistant's tools.
Absolute path handling for the scratchpad dump script needed a manual python3 fixup after the first esbuild attempt used a broken relative path.
open_items: Catalogue currently ships zero media (GIFs/images/stills) for all moods; the media plumbing (Media type, staleness marker, two-column layout) remains in place but fully unexercised by real data until someone sources verified Machiavelli-appropriate imagery.

Quote wording follows common English translations (Marriott, Detmold) rather than a single citable edition; the specific chapter for each quote is recorded only in code comments, not shown on the page.
Deployed identifiers (repo name, Worker name, REDIRECT_URI) still say 'tedlasso-strava' — intentionally deferred since renaming affects the live URL and Strava OAuth callback.
